objective: Which traffic channel brings visits that turn into revenue?
instruction: A business is preparing a marketing & customers analysis. The question is: Which traffic channel brings visits that turn into revenue. The tile covers Compare sessions, conversions, conversion rate and revenue per session across your acquisition channels, with organic-search click-through when you declare it. The declared figures are: channels row 1: name organic search, sessions 42000, conversions 1350, revenue 680000; row 2: name paid search, sessions 24000, conversions 960, revenue 430000; row 3: name email, sessions 9000, conversions 540, revenue 260000; organic impressions 600000; organic clicks 24000. Use web traffic and conversion by channel in a competitive market and industry context, and report the method's result.
